purpose: Settle the acquisition queue's own caveat — that group C was never reconciled against the Nationwide folder — using the committed file-level indices of that folder and of the Master Library.

theWorkbookQuestion.theQueueSays: nothing outstanding by URL. `private/Nationwide Record Clearing/` is still not in this clone, but its committed file-level index is, and data/rcap-all50/archive-reconciliation.json joins every row here against it: no forms-links workbook exists in that folder, and group C is an overcount for a different reason — 12 of its 13 rows have their pinned bytes indexed at a named path in an archive.
theWorkbookQuestion.whatTheIndexShows: The committed index of that folder, walked 2026-06-17T12:10:37.013Z, lists 425 files across 51 jurisdictions, by extension: .pdf 289, .html 90, .rtf 27, .docx 7, .doc 6, (none) 4, .aspx 2. There is no spreadsheet in it — no .xlsx, .xls, .csv or .tsv — so no forms-links workbook was present in the folder as walked.
theWorkbookQuestion.thereforeGroupCIs: not an overcount because of a workbook. It is an overcount for a different and better-evidenced reason: the folder holds the FORMS themselves, and the pinned bytes of most group C assets are in it.
